title: Pilot & flight preparation
items: He/she is physically fit for flight
Is not under the influence of alcohol or drugs
It is permissible to fly in the proposed area

title: Aircraft structure
items: Ensure cantilever arms secure and rigid at joints
All critical fasteners marked with red torque-seal paint are secure and show no signs of loosening, fracture, or misalignment.

title: Propellers
items: Make sure they are securely attached
Check propeller tie wire fixing is intact
Check all marked joints show no evidence of movement or misalignment.

title: Motors
items: Check to ensure no excessive play
Ensure there are no foreign objects

title: Battery system
items: Check to ensure no bulge in the battery

title: Ballistic recovery system
notice: Source review needed: the supplied Flight Manual contains an unresolved editorial question about whether the BRS safety pin should be removed before flight. The checklist wording is reproduced from the supplied checklist. Confirm this procedure with the manufacturer before operational use.

title: Main power connection
items: Confirm both main power connectors are disconnected
Connect Front Battery QS12 Main Power Connector
Connect Rear Battery QS12 Main Power Connector
notice: Do not connect or disconnect QS12 connectors under electrical load. Do not short-circuit battery terminals. Do not operate with damaged connectors.

title: High-voltage inspection
items: QS12 connectors undamaged and in good condition
Locking mechanism is normal and functional
notice: HayesX-250 utilizes a dual 108V DC electrical power system. The front and rear battery packs are connected to the aircraft’s main power system through QS12 high-voltage connectors. High-voltage system maintenance shall only be performed by trained personnel. Do not connect or disconnect QS12 connectors under electrical load. Do not short-circuit battery terminals. Do not operate with damaged connectors. If any of the following occurs: • Abnormal arcing • Burning smell • Connector overheating • System startup failure Disconnect power immediately and discontinue operation.

title: System initialization
notice: After both battery systems are connected, the Flight Control System powers up automatically.

title: Propulsion system
items: Eight green status indicators illuminated continuously
notice: Inspect all eight propulsion arm control modules:

title: Boarding
items: Ensure aircraft is stable and secure before boarding
